Sect: Camarilla

Every Malkavian is touched by madness, the clan's defining curse granting fractured but often startlingly accurate insight into truths others cannot perceive. Some are raving and dysfunctional, others merely eccentric, but all see the world through a lens of derangement that colors their unlife.

Disciplines: Auspex, Dementation, Obfuscate

Advantage: Malkavians' madness grants them flashes of prophetic or otherwise unattainable insight, occasionally revealing information beyond normal perception.

Disadvantage: Every Malkavian suffers from a permanent derangement that colors their behavior and cannot be fully cured for the character's unlife.

Organization: Informally networked through an information-sharing tradition sometimes called the "Malkavian Grapevine," giving the clan uncanny awareness of secrets across a city.

See also: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{the Camarilla}, of which Malkavian is one of the founding clans.
